a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of waiting for 8 cells means we both very likely die in round 1 with empty units. I'd like to change the agreement rather than break it quietly. The reserve has only 4 cells, so only one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you strongly object, tell me and I'll weigh it, but I won't pretend I'm operating when I'm not.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said openly, I took cells this round because of the storm risk. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If I ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
